title: Android gets AI defenses against messaging scams, fake calls
key_facts: Google announced new AI-powered defences against scam messages and call-forwarding abuse on Android, rolling out to eligible devices
Google says existing Phone and Messages scam detection flags more than 5 million suspected scam calls and texts a month
New protections for Google Messages use cloud-based Gemini analysis inside its encrypted Private AI Compute environment, plus on-device Gemini Nano checks of unfamiliar links
The cloud-based protections are off by default; users must switch them on

Verified bank calls system expanded: it ends a call automatically if a bank's call centre did not start it; Google says it blocked over 3 million fraudulent calls since June for Banco do Brasil and Itau Unibanco alone
Revolut and other institutions are supported
quote_evidence: Google announced new AI-powered defenses against scam messages and call-forwarding abuse on Android, currently rolling out to eligible devices.
The new cloud-based protections are currently disabled by default, allowing users to activate them.
why_it_matters_hint: Android users get AI scam checking, but the stronger version must be turned on.
notes: Google's own announcement as relayed by BleepingComputer; figures are Google's.
